comment: Voices for Scripts/BuildVoices.py (Kokoro-82M, Apache 2.0). voice: a Kokoro voice id, or a blend {id: weight}. lang: en-gb or en-us pronunciation. speed: 1.0 is the voice's natural pace. Lines are collected from Data/Dialogue.json, Data/Missions/*.json (interviews) and Data/Events.json (colleagues who walk over), plus the fixed lines below that live in the game code.

adrian.note: Chief Executive: measured, used to the stage

grace.note: Head of Health and Safety: plain-spoken

helen.note: Board Risk Committee chair: unhurried authority

approach.comment: Colleagues who walk over to deliver an inbox message (ARbHUD::TickApproach). Categories and excluded senders match that code.
approach.busy: You're busy. It's in your inbox.

fixed.text:
Welcome to Valtren Coldline Logistics. Straight to it: Bay 3 at our Northgate cold store had another temperature excursion last night. 42,000 of client stock written off, and that is the third excursion in six months.

Our register still rates R-014 as Medium with Effective controls, and nobody has reviewed it in 14 months. I want your independent assessment. Start with the incident report in your inbox and the R-014 entry, both on your workstation in the analyst workspace. Then find out whether the controls actually work.

When you are ready, complete the assessment form on your workstation and come back here for a debrief.
